family.description: This entry, previously known as DUF1116, represents Oxamate carbamoyltransferase subunit AllG and related bacterial proteins. AllG is a component of a carbamoyltransferase involved in the anaerobic nitrogen utilisation via the assimilation of allantoin [[cite:PUB00155434]]. It is catalyses the conversion of oxalurate (N-carbamoyl-2-oxoglycine) to oxamate and carbamoyl phosphate.
family.name: Oxamate carbamoyltransferase subunit AllG
